Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: In the final synthesis, the Planner swapped the directors’ death years—stating Thomas Carr died in 1964 and Frank R. Strayer in 1997—despite the gathered sources showing Strayer died in 1964 and Carr in 1997. This inversion led to the incorrect conclusion that The Daltons' Women had the director who died earlier, instead of Tangled Destinies.
